append.detail: Built 2026-11-10: migration 20270346039000_hunt_rewards.sql adds hunt_rewards (spec, stock, granted_count, per-player limit, published stock terms; a check keeps granted_count within stock) and hunt_reward_grants (one per reward and run), both service role only, and public.hunt_reward_grant. The function serialises on the reward row, so two qualifying players racing the last unit allocate exactly one; the loser reads sold_out with the stock terms the reward published. It checks run, Hunt status (live or ended), eligibility (run completed, or every named mission credited) and the per-player limit, then writes the grant, the count, an audit row, one outbox row (consumer reward) and the idempotency record together. lib/hunts/rewards.ts holds the validated spec, the eligibility rule, the request hash, the narrowed answer and the player-facing words. Proof: supabase/tests/hunt_rewards.test.sql on the sequential path, and a by-hand two-session run against Postgres 16 where the second claimant waited on the lock and answered sold_out. Money, revocation and redemption are other rows (FH-022 and the commerce rows). Behind HUNTS_REWARDS_ENABLED at the route. The migration is NOT applied in production until the owner runs it.
